parent_objective: design bounded reset-validation adapter for M2391 effective candidate pack artifacts
blocked_by: M2391 materialized effective candidate pack artifacts but did not reset them
existing M2388 validator expects one env_config per candidate and must be adapted to pack-scoped selected scenario specs
supersedes: direct reset validation with the old overlay-only candidate validator
direct measured execution, repair execution, training, or ranking from M2391 artifacts

public_gates: M2393 must design a reset-validation adapter for M2391 effective candidate pack artifacts without running it
M2393 must define input artifacts, duplicate-handling policy, reset budget, pass/fail fields, and claim boundary
M2393 must preserve no active config overwrite, no policy action, and no environment step after reset
M2393 must register a bounded implementation follow-up or stop the branch
M2393 must not load/reset environments, execute repair, train, rank, or make paper/self-ID/current-sim claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not inject hidden or oracle features
do not rank support policies or controller families
do not overwrite the active scenario config
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim training repair success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs the executable reset-only validation adapter needed after M2391 effective candidate materialization
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: reset-validation adapter design only; no environment load/reset/rollout, repair execution, ranking, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, or current-sim verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if adapter design would require active config overwrite
stop if adapter design would step environments or execute policy actions
stop if adapter design routes directly to measured execution, training, ranking, or paper conclusions
stop if reset budget or duplicate-handling policy is unspecified
fallback_plan: route to bounded reset-validation adapter implementation if design is complete
pivot to schema simplification if selected scenario references are too broad to validate safely
stop for user review if no bounded reset-only route is supported
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2392 synthesis decision continue admits a reset-validation adapter design milestone

allowed_updates: M2393 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the design
next_stage_criteria: adapter input artifact contract is defined
reset budget and duplicate-handling policy are defined
implementation follow-up is registered or branch stops

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2393 designs reset validation and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2393; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU comparison verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M2391 effective candidate materialization and M2392 synthesis.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Reset-validation adapter design remains task-quality infrastructure and cannot be interpreted as driver capability or self-ID evidence.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: can unblock executable reset-only validation of effective candidate artifacts
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can prepare current-sim validation readiness but cannot establish paper verdict
must_synthesize_if: M2393 proposes another artifact-only step before reset validation
M2393 cannot define reset budget or duplicate-handling policy
the repair-plan materialization branch reaches 10 milestones without synthesis

hypothesis: A bounded design can adapt reset-only validation to M2391 effective candidate pack artifacts by reading selected scenario env_config entries without active config overwrite, policy action, repair execution, ranking, or training-success claims.
success_criteria: input artifacts and selected scenario schema are specified
reset budget and duplicate-handling policy are specified
pass/fail output fields and claim boundary are specified
a bounded implementation follow-up is registered or the branch stops
no environment load/reset/rollout repair training ranking or paper/self-ID/current-sim claim occurs
failure_criteria: M2393 steps environments or executes policy actions
M2393 executes repair levers or trains
M2393 ranks support policies or controller families
M2393 overwrites the active scenario config
M2393 makes paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU current-sim verdict or level3 self-ID claims
M2393 claims scenario redesign executed or training repair success

commands.name: design
commands.command: write bounded effective candidate reset-validation adapter design

decision_rule: M2393 passes if it designs a bounded reset-only validation adapter and follow-up route without environment load/reset, active config overwrite, ranking, training, or paper/self-ID/current-sim verdict claims.
